Contact Us close menu IR FAQ We are answering some of the most frequently asked questions from our investors. Clicking on a question will display the answer. Dividends, Shareholder Benefits Stock Procedures Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders Dividends, Shareholder Benefits What is the trading unit for stocks? 100 shares. By when do I need to purchase the stock to receive dividends? To receive dividends, you must purchase the shares by the ex-dividend date, which is two business days before the record date (May 31st for interim dividends, November 30th year-end dividends). For details regarding the ex-dividend date, please contact your securities company. When are the dividend payments due? Dividend payments are made twice a year, with year-end dividend scheduled for early February and the interim dividend for early August. I haven't received my dividend receipt. What should I do? Please contact Stock Transfer Agency Department, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited which is the administrator of the shareholder register. お問い合わせ先： 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） I would like to arrange for my dividend payments to be deposited into my bank account. How do I do that? If you have an account with a securities company, please contact your securities company. If you do not have an account with a securities company, please contact Stock Transfer Agency Department, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited. お問い合わせ先： 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） 引越しをしましたが、株主優待品は新しい住所に届きますか？ 株主優待品を引越し先に配送していただけますか？ 株主優待品は、11月30日現在の株主名簿に記載された住所に送付しています。引越しによる住所変更、住居表示変更があった方は、下記の手続きを行ってください。 （1） 11月30日までに手続きをされる場合 証券会社に口座を開設されている方は口座のある証券会社へ、証券会社に口座を開設されていない方は、三井住友信託銀行株式会社 証券代行部までご連絡ください。 お問い合わせ先： 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） （2） 12月1日以降に手続きをされる場合 （1）の手続きとあわせ、お近くの郵便局に転居届をご提出ください。 Stock Procedures Where can I inquire about procedures related to stocks? For stock-related procedures, please contact your brokerage firm if you have an account. If you do not have an account with a brokerage firm, please contact the address below. Mailing Address 168-0063 2-8-4 Izumi, Suginami-ku, Tokyo Stock Transfer Agency Department, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited お問い合わせ先 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） Website https://www.smtb.jp/personal/procedure/agency How do I go about changing my address, name, and other personal information? To ensure that we can send you notices of general meeting of shareholders' meeting, dividend notices, and shareholder benefits with the correct address and name, we need to update your shareholder register. If you have an account with a securities company, please contact your securities company. If you do not have an account with a securities company, please contact Stock Transfer Agency Department, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited. お問い合わせ先： 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） How do I change the bank account details for receiving dividend payments? If you have an account with a securities company, please contact your securities company. If you do not have an account with a securities company, please contact Stock Transfer Agency Department, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited. お問い合わせ先： 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） How do I go about buying or selling fractional shares? We do not have a system for purchasing fractional shares. For requests to purchase fractional shares, please contact your securities company if you have an account with one, or the Securities Agency Stock Transfer Agency Department, Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Bank, Limited if you do not have an account with a securities company. お問い合わせ先： 0120-782-031（9:00～17:00 土・日・祝日および12/31～1/3を除く） How do I sell my shares? You can sell your shares through your securities company, so please contact the securities company where you have your trading account. Ordinary General Meeting of Shareholders Please tell me the date and location of ordinary general meeting of shareholders. ordinary general meeting of shareholders is held in late February every year. For more details, please see general meeting of shareholders page. Can people who are not shareholders attend general meeting of shareholders? According to the articles of incorporation, attendance by anyone other than shareholders is not permitted. Are there any souvenirs at ordinary general meeting of shareholders? In consideration of fairness between shareholders who are able to attend the event and those who are unable to, we will not be providing any souvenirs. その他のお問い合わせにつきましては、以下までご連絡ください。 お問い合せ先：キユーピー株式会社 電話番号（代表） 03-3486-3331 受付時間 9:00～17:00 （土・日・祝日および夏期休暇や年末年始を除く） Investors 株主・投資家の皆さまへ トップ Why Invest in Kewpie Management Information Top Message 2030 VISION and Medium-Term Management Plan Business Risks Corporate Governance ESG Information Corporate History Our Business Overseas Expansion Business Model Financial Information Financial Highlights Segment Information Cash Flows Financial Data IR Library IR Events Financial Results Annual Securities Report Integrated Report Kewpie Newsletter (Shareholder Newsletter) Stock Information Dividend Information 株主優待情報 General Meetings of Shareholders Stock Procedures Share Overview Stock Price Bonds and Ratings Analyst Coverage IR Calendar IR FAQ IRメールマガジン Disclosure policy Electronic Public Notice Disclaimer Top page Investors IR FAQ レシピ・商品 Global 英語サイトへ移動します 企業情報 トップメッセージ 基本方針 キユーピーの約束 会社概要 グループの事業 市販用 業務用 海外 フルーツソリューション ファインケミカル 食育活動 マヨネーズ教室 食をテーマにした講演会 マヨテラス オープンキッチン 食に関する情報提供 サステナビリティ トップメッセージ サステナビリティ マネジメント 資源の有効活用・循環 生物多様性の保全 食と健康への貢献 持続可能な調達 人権の尊重 ガバナンス 品質と安全・安心 研究開発 本部長メッセージ 研究開発ビジョン 研究開発体制 研究開発スタイル 学会発表・論文 イノベーション ストーリー 株主・投資家の皆さまへ 決算短信 有価証券報告書 財務・業績情報 IRイベント 株主優待品 採用情報 キユーピーグループオフィシャルブログ ニュースリリース サイトマップ サイトポリシー プライバシーポリシー ソーシャルメディアポリシー アクセシビリティ Copyright © Kewpie Corporation All rights reserved.
